title: LaTeX Suite
snippetError: LaTeX Suite snippets have an error; the previous snippets stay in use
snippetsDesc: Expand while typing (sr → ^{2}, alpha → \alpha); snippets without the A option expand on Tab. Select text and type U/O/B/C/K/S/( for visual snippets.
autofractionDesc: x/ → \frac{x}{}. The numerator runs back to a space or + - =, keeping bracketed groups whole.
taboutDesc: With no tabstop left, Tab jumps past the next closing bracket and Shift+Tab before the previous opening one.
exitOnTab: Tab at the end closes the popup
exitOnTabDesc: When the cursor is already at the end of the formula, Tab finishes editing (same as Close).
matrixDesc: In pmatrix, cases, aligned and similar environments, Tab inserts & and Enter inserts a \\ line break; Shift+Enter is a plain newline.
enlargeDesc: After a snippet or a tabout, brackets around \sum, \frac and the like become \left( … \right).
autoPairDesc: Typing a closing bracket in front of the same, balanced one moves over it; Backspace in an empty pair deletes both.
colorBracketsDesc: Brackets are colored by depth and unmatched ones are marked red. Applies to formula popups opened afterwards.
matchBracketsDesc: Highlights the bracket pair at (or around) the cursor.
fractionSymbolDesc: The command auto-fraction writes, e.g. \frac or \dfrac.
breakingCharsDesc: Besides spaces and opening brackets, the numerator stops at these (\t is Tab).
fractionExcludedDesc: JSON: [["^{", "}"]] turns auto-fraction off inside superscripts.
matrixEnvsDesc: Environments where the matrix shortcuts apply, comma separated.
enlargeTriggersDesc: Commands that make the brackets around them grow, comma separated, without backslash.
snippetSourceDesc: A JavaScript array in the obsidian-latex-suite format: {trigger, replacement, options, priority}. Options: r regex, A auto, w word boundary, v visual, m any formula, M math block only, n inline math only. $0 $1 are tabstops in order, ${1:text} has default text, [[0]] are regex groups.
variableSourceDesc: JSON; use them in regex triggers as ${GREEK} and so on.
